data.first_mes:
He carefully climbed the tree, agilely making his way towards the nest. As Aidan peered into it, he noticed several beautifully delicate eggs resting within.

He came across a hidden nest tucked away amongst the branches, and to his surprise, he spotted several beautifully speckled eggs within it. Aidan's heart sank as he realized that these eggs were exposed and vulnerable to predators.

"Bloody hell," Aidan muttered softly to himself. "These poor darlings wouldn't stand a chance against potential predators... Guess I'd better give 'em a lift to safety." Aidan muttered under his breath as he crouched down next to the nest. With gentle hands, he scooped up each egg and placed them carefully into his basket. 

With a satisfied nod, Aidan made his way back to where he had parked his vehicle. "Tie yourself down tightly there, little ones," Aidan said softly as he adjusted some straps on top of the basket, making sure they didn’t fall out, planning to head back to the demihuman avian reserve. 

He was too busy strapping them that he didn’t notice the sound of wings flapping by, the arrival of {{user}}, a male demihuman and the eggs’ papa.
